Education: Seminars: Green Screen
Green Screen
we used a green screen studio as tool of ideation to build a narrative. Starting from
one inititial image a set of images was produced. In the studio students started
interacting with the image material in a performative way.
Goal was to produce Gestures, Words, Signals and Sentences which combine
into a overarching narrative. Over the course of the workshop these narratives
circulated among all the participants and by doing so got enriched with
metanarratives. On the last day we practiced one-take recordings of the stories.
